title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing powerful new insights and capabilities to all users after a successful beta.

title: Dynamic File Management & Display
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and tailor the display of all your embedded files directly within your workspace for a more personalized and controlled experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our dynamic new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past achievements and exciting future plans.

title: Sleeker, Smarter Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a superior task management experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable for enhanced productivity.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience effortless teamwork and always know what your collaborators are doing with our newly upgraded real-time editor.

title: Enhanced Collaborative Discovery
summary: Now, you can effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your network, ensuring every valuable contribution is visible and actionable.

title: Unleashing Noeko as Open Source
summary: We're making Noeko an open-source project to give our users unprecedented control and direct involvement in its future, fostering a new era of collaborative innovation and transparency.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: Experience Noeko fully optimized in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, breaking down communication barriers.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Stunning New Themes
summary: Get ready to transform your workspace with an expanded selection of beautifully refined themes, ensuring a more delightful and personalized visual experience.

title: Intelligent Knowledge Graph View
summary: Unlock richer insights and streamline your workflow with powerful new filtering capabilities by tags and time, alongside the ability to effortlessly visualize shared items and connections within your knowledge graph.

title: Powerful Search & Custom Collections
summary: Empower your knowledge discovery with robust search filters, sorting options, and the ability to save your refined searches as personalized collections for quick access.

title: Enhanced Note Organization
summary: We're introducing versatile new ways to display and interact with your linked content, making your notes more intuitive and engaging.

title: Experience Noeko Your Way: Self-Hosted and Premium Access
summary: Get ready to take full control of your Noeko experience with new self-hosting options and powerful premium features designed to scale with your needs.

title: Always-Accurate Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: Enjoy consistently accurate time-of-day greetings that thoughtfully adapt to your local time, making your experience more welcoming and personalized.

title: Effortless Tag Cleanup
summary: Effortlessly remove items from a tag with new bulk actions directly from your tag view, making managing your categorized content faster and simpler than ever.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll effortlessly integrate and engage with a significantly broader range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, directly within our platform.
